snippet.title: DISBELIEF (Papyrus's Genocide Route) [Undertale]
snippet.description:
[ * Papyrus no longer believes in you... ]


This is a fan animation - NOT gameplay footage of Undertale (or any Undertale fangame!)
For that, please check out Undertale: Disbelief, the official fangame based on this animation.
Link to download: https://gamejolt.com/games/disbelief/268091
(Currently in demo, follow the game page for development updates.)

[ * Psst! Trying to spare Papyrus? ]
[ * Hit the card in the top right corner when Papyrus first shows you mercy! ]


*IMPORTANT INFORMATION*
Please do not react/dub or otherwise share this video anywhere else online.
I worked very very hard on this for 7 months straight (yikes), and I do not allow for the redestribution of my content.

*MUSIC USED*
All music in this video is used with permission from its owners.
- "Once Upon A Time (Orchestral Cover)" by Pennoink (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=poU6FMG9D4s)
- "MEGALOVANIA" by Toby Fox (https://youtube.com/watch?v=0FCvzsVlXpQ)
- "Interstellar Retribution" by Rock Candy (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NotsoTlX4vE)
- "Phase 2" by Jimmy The Bassist (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pIKAxdzVesw)
- "The Choice" by Toby Fox (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x1WBMSIGBDM)
- "But the Earth Grew a Spine" by Jimmy The Bassist (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIpoPn50bYU)
- "Backbone" by Sean Evans ~ Lone (https://soundcloud.com/nine-zero-music/backbone)
- "Final Chance" by flamesatgames (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QNauBmhJOCE)
- "Last Goodbye" by Toby Fox (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EpBQ5m3Ag3Q)

A warm and most special thanks to Jimmy The Bassist, who not only provided the masterfully crafted "Phase 2" music for this
animation as a favor (for someone he had basically just met), but also taught and inspired me to explore the world of music for myself.

Undertale by Toby Fox.
______________________________________
